text: APPROVE. `AppendStar` reproduces the original `*`, `**/` and trailing `**` branches exactly (same regex fragments, same index advance before the loop's `i++`), so behaviour is unchanged. The helper is a plain private static method with no new warning sources, and moving the nested branches out of `ToRegex` lowers its cognitive complexity well below 16. I judged this from the diff alone and did not run the build or the complexity analyzer.
